On this tour you move from prehistoric shelters to a major medieval temple while separating chronologies.

A day-by-day itinerary and a quotation are shared before you commit. Route, pace, accommodation and budget are adjusted to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Morning Bhimbetka permitted shelters
  • Drive and meal buffer
  • Afternoon Bhojpur temple
  • Comparison of rock surfaces across periods

Day by day

  1. Morning Bhimbetka permitted shelters

  2. Drive and meal buffer

  3. Afternoon Bhojpur temple

  4. Comparison of rock surfaces across periods

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Describe the permitted painted shelters at Bhimbetka as evidence from a prehistoric landscape.
  • Read the Bhojpur temple as a major medieval monument built in stone.
  • Compare rock surfaces across periods while keeping prehistoric and medieval chronologies separate.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
